A perusal of reliefs claimed by the petitioners unmistakably shows that they are seeking enhancement of the amount of compensation which has been awarded to them for the compulsory acquisition of their lands under the provisions of Right of Fair Compensation and Transperency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by way of award dated 31.07.2014 and 16.11.2015 and the Rehabilitation and Resettlement package awarded to them on 19.01.2017.

sentences.text: Admittedly, the petitioners have an alternate remedy of making a reference under Section 64 of the Act, 2013 before the competent authority as provided therein.
The instant petition filed directly for seeking enhancement of the amount of compensation for the land, houses etc. awarded under the awards is not maintainable.
There are no particulars whatsoever as regards the Rehabilitation and Resettlement benefits to which the petitioners are entitled which may not have been granted to them.
Thus, in view of the reliefs as claimed for by petitioners in this petition, the same is held to be not maintainable and is accordingly dismissed.
